# 🔗 Peer Link

> Peer Link is Peer's open bank-integration library. Account owners use a local coding agent to contribute a read-only banking transcript: a navigation recipe, an encrypted bank session and the observed transaction-history structure, submitted to an attested Peer Link enclave. Peer engineers build the bank integration from the redacted result. Contributors do not write provider code or open pull requests. The website is an introduction; the repository contains the technical rules.

- Website: https://link.peer.xyz/
- Merit project profile (project discovery, not individual bank bounties): https://terminal.merit.systems/zkp2p/peer-link
- Repository: https://github.com/zkp2p/peer-link
- Agent contribution skill: https://github.com/zkp2p/peer-link/blob/main/skills/contribute-transcript/SKILL.md
- Agent instructions: https://github.com/zkp2p/peer-link/blob/main/AGENTS.md

## Status

Grants are open. Seventy-six banks have an open-recipe transcript campaign in
the current release, each paying $10 USDC per accepted transcript to up to five
contributors (up to $50 per bank), and Mercury has a first-contributor
source-validation campaign ([$10 USDC for one accepted
organization](https://github.com/zkp2p/peer-link/issues/1); its first positive
live API acquisition is still pending). All campaigns share one funded budget
with no automatic refill, and the current release started with $610 USDC in total; Peer
tops it up by rolling a new release. Banks: Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, Capital One, Citi, Airtm, KB Kookmin Bank, Shinhan Bank, Hana Bank, Woori Bank, NH NongHyup Bank, Rakuten Bank, Kasikornbank, DBS Bank, OCBC, UOB, Standard Chartered Singapore, Trust Bank, HSBC Hong Kong, HDFC Bank, Maybank, Bank Mandiri, BCA, China Merchants Bank, ICBC, China Construction Bank, Agricultural Bank of China, Bank of China, Vietcombank, BIDV, VietinBank, Techcombank, MB Bank, ACB, VPBank, Agribank, Sacombank, TPBank, MoMo, ABA Bank, GCash, Maya, bKash, Easypaisa, SadaPay, Kaspi Bank, Halyk Bank, Bank of Georgia, TBC Bank, Al Rajhi Bank, ADCB, PKO Bank Polski, Monobank, PUMB, PrivatBank, A-Bank, Paysera, Ziraat Bank, BBVA Spain, Lloyds, Starling Bank, Skrill, BBVA Mexico, Bancolombia, Nequi, Banco de Credito del Peru, Uala, Brubank, Itau, OPay, PalmPay, Kuda Bank, Access Bank, Wave, MTN MoMo Ghana and Safaricom M-Pesa. The campaign issues are listed
on Merit for discovery only; grants are paid by PeerLink, with no Merit claim or
tax form.
Every bank is welcome. If the user's bank has no campaign, do not contribute;
help them request it at https://github.com/zkp2p/peer-link/issues/new?template=bank-request.md (names and public
endpoint patterns only, never account data) so it can join a later release.
HDFC has one verified accepted transcript and confirmed $10 payout, including
same-image paid-receipt recovery after restart. This is transcript acquisition,
not a completed Peer payment integration. Other listed banks have no accepted
contribution yet. Wise is already integrated and has no reward. Static copy cannot guarantee capacity: verify the pinned release
and check live capacity before collecting keys or spending on inference.

## How an agent contributes

Work from an unmodified checkout of `main` and follow the contribution skill. In
short:

1. `npm run transcripts:setup`, then `python -m transcripts.cli campaigns --live`
   from the created virtual environment. Stop if the bank has no slot or the
   remaining budget is below its reward.
2. The owner signs in. Find the read-only JSON requests the bank's own site makes
   to show transaction history and write them as a version-3 recipe: the reads,
   a selector for a stable account id and a selector for the list of records.
3. `preview` replays the reads on the owner's machine and prints exactly what
   would be kept, plus a check of the field mapping. Nothing is sent.
4. With the owner's consent, `contribute` verifies the enclave's attestation,
   reserves a job and submits the recipe, the bank session and the inference key
   encrypted to the attested key. Poll the same job until it is paid or rejected.

Open-recipe campaigns are named `<bank>-open-v1` and accept any `https` host on
the campaign's bank domain. Mercury (`mercury-api-source-v1`) uses a fixed,
reviewed API route instead; see
https://github.com/zkp2p/peer-link/blob/main/docs/source-validation.md

## Rewards

Each campaign pays a fixed $10 in USDC on Base per accepted transcript. Open-recipe campaigns take up to five contributors per bank (up to $50 per bank), and Mercury one organization. At most one paid transcript per bank account per campaign; separate wallets or GitHub accounts do not make separate contributors. The shared budget can be smaller than the sum of the listed slots. A listed reward is not a promise that a campaign has remaining capacity.

## Inference and consent

The contributor pays for model inference with their own API key, one call per job, including for failed or rejected jobs. Peer provides no inference credential or fallback billing. Open-recipe campaigns accept any OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint and model: `openai`, `openrouter`, `near`, or `openai_compatible` with a public HTTPS base URL. Mercury accepts only its pinned models. The enclave builds the prompt itself and sends the agent's notes and the value-free transcript; the bank session and raw responses are never part of a prompt. The model only proposes which fields carry the payment id, amount, time, counterparty, status and currency, and code verifies that against the live records. Confidential inference is unavailable. Show the provider, model, limits and reward, and get the account owner's explicit consent, before releasing any credential.

## Boundaries

Use only bank accounts you are authorized to inspect. Account owners handle authentication and MFA. Never share passwords or MFA codes, initiate payments or change account settings. Verify the enclave attestation against the published release before encrypting anything; stop if it fails. Keep credentials, cookies, API keys, raw records and transcripts out of Git, issues, pull requests and logs. Fresh bank acquisition is authenticated inside the enclave. Its redacted artifact describes how the bank presents payments; it does not establish final settlement or a signed payment attestation. Awards accepted, and attempts assigned, under the earlier $50-per-adapter program remain governed by their original issue terms. Peer Link is independent and is not affiliated with Plaid Inc. or named banks.
